description: This file 'timeval.c' contains platform-specific implementations for obtaining the current time and calculating time differences, used within the libcurl library to provide high-resolution, monotonic time measurements across different operating systems.

methods.name: struct:curltime Curl_now(void)
methods.description: Returns the current monotonic time as a 'curltime' structure, using platform-specific APIs depending on the environment.

methods.name: timediff_t Curl_timediff(struct curltime newer,struct curltime older)
methods.description: Calculates the difference in milliseconds between two 'curltime' values.

methods.name: timediff_t Curl_timediff_ceil(struct curltime newer,struct curltime older)
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of the time difference in milliseconds between two 'curltime' values.

methods.name: timediff_t Curl_timediff_us(struct curltime newer,struct curltime older)
methods.description: Calculates the difference in microseconds between two 'curltime' values.

ctags.name: Curl_timediff
ctags.pattern: /^timediff_t Curl_timediff(struct curltime newer, struct curltime older)$/

ctags.name: Curl_timediff_ceil
ctags.pattern: /^timediff_t Curl_timediff_ceil(struct curltime newer, struct curltime older)$/

ctags.name: Curl_timediff_us
ctags.pattern: /^timediff_t Curl_timediff_us(struct curltime newer, struct curltime older)$/
